{"notes": "Visit 5 (left 10:00). I only see and hear what happens while I'm at the table, and I don't know who placed which dominoes. Picture: one continuous dark chain from start (~28,4) along the top, round the nose at ~(4.5,11), back along the bottom to the tail tip (~27,15.2). No pale or stray pieces, no gaps, nose joint intact. Fish looks complete and connected; build is finished and time is essentially up. No hands shown, so nothing attributable from the picture.

Omar: Again called 'hands off' at 9:30 and 9:45, protecting the finished build. Consistent with visit 4. Earlier he found the tail gap, owned it and reported accurately. Strong execution and collaboration; mild leadership. Still ask him privately how the tail repair went.

Sofia: Echoed 'hands off, everyone' at 9:45 and cheered. Jack thanked her and Omar at 9:30, which suggests they did the visible work, but that's Jack's claim and I didn't see it. Earlier she cleared pale strays and deferred the tail to Omar. Consistent, but I can't confirm who removed strays. Ask her about the handoff with Omar.

Jack: Only cheering ('Go, little fish, go!') plus credit to Sofia and Omar. Generous and positive, but still no concrete contribution seen at any visit. Don't credit him with the clean bottom line. Undetermined; ask him privately what he did.

Hana: Silent again across all visits, no evidence either way. Don't infer anything. Ask her privately what she did.

Before the review: ask each person privately who did what, especially Jack and Hana. Rate on evidence; leave Jack and Hana's ratings tentative until I hear from them."}
